acceptance: A fresh direct load of `https://benchbox.dev/results/` initializes DuckDB and displays the published results overview without a worker timeout.
A fresh direct load of `https://benchbox.dev/results/query` resolves through the static fallback into a usable Find runs page with published rows.
A direct query filter/share URL restores its selected filters and displays matching results.
In-app navigation to Find runs still works, and the Explorer reports no initialization or data-loading errors.
Verify the fix in the deployed site after an authorized deployment; before that, verify the candidate build and record the live deployment limitation.
context: Live production smoke on 2026-10-11: initial overview tab loaded the snapshot and 414 rows; in-app navigation to `/results/query` rendered rows and filters. Two fresh direct query-tab attempts returned a static-host 404 and then `DuckDB instantiate did not respond within 30000ms`. After closing query tabs, a fresh overview tab also timed out during DuckDB instantiation (304 snapshot response, no rendered results). The failure affects cold-start bootstrap in this automation session; root cause and behavior in an independent browser profile remain unverified. Candidate full-surface evidence is recorded in `_project/audits/docs-remediation-full-surface-audit-2026-10-11.md`, inventory source `435ff8b884d6af12703238c8850b894a276e882d`. The user authorized continued work on the unmerged PR stack, so this follow-up no longer depends on the audit task reaching its merge/live evidence gate. As of 2026-10-11 the active todo-db did not advertise registered-batch support/schema; verify again, and use serial mode if still absent.
description: Fresh production Chromium tabs failed to initialize the Results Explorer. Direct `/results/query` returned HTTP 404, ran the configured `/results/` SPA fallback, then displayed `DuckDB instantiate did not respond within 30000ms`; a separate fresh `/results/` tab also ended with that worker initialization error. In contrast, an already initialized overview navigated in-app to Find runs and displayed 414 rows. The root cause is not isolated; investigate cold-start worker/WASM initialization and the direct-route fallback rather than treating this as a query-filter-only bug.
